prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 重点城市季度GDP增速对比表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "城市" spans 1 col × 2 row; "季度增速（%）" spans 4 col × 1 row; "说明" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 17px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "城市" · longest unbreakable word 18px · one-line width 35px
  col 2: header "季度增速（%） › 一季度" · longest unbreakable word 25px · one-line width 53px
  col 3: header "季度增速（%） › 二季度" · longest unbreakable word 25px · one-line width 53px
  col 4: header "季度增速（%） › 三季度" · longest unbreakable word 25px · one-line width 53px
  col 5: header "季度增速（%） › 四季度" · longest unbreakable word 25px · one-line width 53px
  col 6: header "说明" · longest unbreakable word 35px · one-line width 867px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 480px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 479px.
Fixed: content, font, 17px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"对比六个重点城市四个季度的GDP增速，并结合说明理解各城市的经济表现。","reading":"读者主要横向比较同一城市的季度变化，也会纵向比较不同城市在同一季度的增速；说明提供背景，通常在发现差异后阅读。说明文字较长，会主导各数据行的高度，因此城市名和增速可以利用同一行已有的高度保持清晰。","groups":["第2至第5列都是季度增速，作用相同，应保持相同宽度，便于横向和纵向比较。","第1列城市名标识整行；第6列说明为该城市的增速提供背景。"],"keep_intact":["城市名称","各季度的增速数值","百分比符号"],"may_wrap":["说明中的中文叙述可自然换行。","空间紧张时，季度子表头可换行；四列应采用一致的宽度和换行节奏。","跨四列的总表头可在必要时换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [56, 74, 74, 74, 74, 127] · table 480×1343px · row heights [39, 39, 250, 224, 197, 197, 197, 197] · column headers wrapped 0/7 · tallest cell 9 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [56, 65, 65, 65, 65, 163] · table 480×1132px · row heights [39, 66, 197, 171, 171, 145, 171, 171] · column headers wrapped 4/7 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [56, 54, 54, 54, 54, 207] · table 480×948px · row heights [39, 92, 145, 145, 118, 118, 145, 145] · column headers wrapped 4/7 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"城市名、季度表头和数值均完整显示，四个等宽季度列便于比较，表头层级清楚。","problems":"说明栏文字过于狭窄，频繁换行使各行很高；数值下方留下大量空白，阅读同一城市的整行内容较费力。","cause":"季度列各占74px，虽能容纳单行表头，却从说明栏占用了较多宽度；说明栏仅127px。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"四个季度列等宽，数值和城市名完整；说明栏比r0A宽，行高有所降低，同一城市的信息更容易一起阅读。","problems":"四个季度表头都把“度”单独挤到第二行，表头节奏一致但显得局促；说明仍有较多短行，数据区下方空白也较明显。","cause":"季度列各65px，文本空间不足以容纳完整的三个汉字；说明栏163px仍需频繁换行。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"说明栏较宽，叙述更易连续阅读，行高更均衡；城市名和数值完整，四列等宽仍支持比较。","problems":"季度表头每字一行，辨认季度时需要竖向拼读，削弱了表头的可扫描性；季度数据区也显得过于拥挤。","cause":"季度列各54px，扣除边距后连两个汉字也放不下；较多宽度被分配给207px的说明栏。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced","widths":[56,57,57,57,57,195],"change":"将季度列从54px增至57px，尝试让每个子表头以两个汉字加一个汉字分两行，同时保留较宽的说明栏。"},{"name":"header-first","widths":[56,74,74,74,74,127],"change":"保留单行季度表头作为可读性优先的参照；若可接受较高的行，这种分配最利于快速扫描季度。"},{"name":"narrative-first","widths":[56,55,55,55,55,203],"change":"测试季度列表头恰好容纳两个汉字的更紧凑宽度，为说明栏争取更多空间；检验浏览器实际断行是否仍能保持两行表头。"}]}
